name: OPERATION: IRON FRONT
description: Single-player open-world military sandbox on the 12 km island of Varden. Free Roam: liberate towns from enemy garrisons with an AI squad, take any car, tank, helicopter, jet or boat, real bullet ballistics, inventory, day/night and weather, sandbox tools.
